headline: Learning summary for 2026-09-01: moneyline record 2-0 (100.0%).

gates.note: Official picks require high model probability and strong setup quality. A high Lab Rating alone is not enough. (Market edge is no longer a gate -- a picked side with a lower market-implied probability than the model's read can still qualify, as long as market data exists for the game at all.)

findings.title: Official-pick discipline
findings.read: 2 moneyline picks were graded today. Record: 2-0 (100.0%).

findings.title: Probability gate
findings.read: No high-Lab, low-probability moneyline setups appeared in the graded official set.

findings.title: What's working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: Over 268 graded picks with a reconciling breakdown, pitching plan is the strongest working piece of Lab Rating right now -- picks scoring above its median win 60.9% of the time vs. 55.6% below (lift +5.3%, correlation to winning +0.098).

findings.title: What's not working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: bullpen -- correlation to winning -0.083, lift -8.1% over 268 picks. Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record.

findings.title: Bullpen learning
findings.read: Across all reviewed days, 9 graded moneyline picks carried a meaningful bullpen caution. Statistically, Lab Rating's bullpen component correlates -0.083 with winning over 268 picks (lift -8.1%). Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record.

findings.title: Pitcher learning
findings.read: No major starting-pitcher conflicts showed up in the graded moneyline set. Statistically, the pitching-plan component correlates +0.098 with winning over 268 picks (lift +5.3%).

findings.title: Rating calibration
findings.read: Actual win rate by Lab Rating band: 0-49 → 54.7% (n=106), 50-64 → 57.6% (n=85), 65-74 → 62.2% (n=45), 75-84 → 66.7% (n=27), 85-100 → 60.0% (n=5). Widest predicted-vs-actual gap is the 85-100 band (-12.7%). The top band has only 5 graded picks so far -- too few to trust its win rate yet, watch as the sample grows.

shadow_model.note: Only rows from the latest matching official/shadow model-version pair are compared. Promote nothing from a mixed-version sample.

attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

calibration.note: Shadow ledger for learning only — never part of the public record. Official picks stay the only published record.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 241-172 (58.4%), n=413. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.
LyDia's own win probability for this pick: r=0.084 (n=413) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.54): 53-50 (51.5%). Top quarter (0.71 to 0.74): 62-42 (59.6%).
Lab Rating's conviction component score: r=0.081 (n=413) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 2.02): 55-48 (53.4%). Top quarter (19.82 to 35.00): 66-38 (63.5%).

Team strength blend edge, before any pitcher/bullpen adjustment (picked side minus opponent): r=0.070 (n=268) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.24 to -0.06): 37-30 (55.2%). Top quarter (0.09 to 0.28): 43-24 (64.2%).
Lab Rating's bullpen component score: r=-0.060 (n=413) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (1.10 to 5.83): 66-37 (64.1%). Top quarter (12.31 to 20.00): 56-48 (53.8%).
Probability points bullpen risk moved this pick's number: r=-0.052 (n=413) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.14 to -0.03): 65-38 (63.1%). Top quarter (0.05 to 0.17): 59-45 (56.7%).

Bullpen risk edge (positive = the picked side's bullpen is the safer one): r=-0.052 (n=413) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-48.00 to -10.00): 64-39 (62.1%). Top quarter (17.00 to 55.00): 59-45 (56.7%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): official_pick 24-11 (68.6%, n=35) vs. watchlist 36-25 (59.0%, n=61) vs. pass 178-132 (57.4%, n=310) vs. value_watch 3-4 (42.9%, n=7).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 140-85 (62.2%, n=225) vs. Road 101-87 (53.7%, n=188).
These are correlations across LyDia's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
